meta.title: 创业拼命到走路养生：人生阶段不同了
meta.title_en: From Grinding to Walking 10K Steps: Different Life Phases

scenes.context: 讲者描述现在走路成为一个任务，一天走七八千到一万步。
sentences: 现在走路啊就是一个任务，我就沿着这个步道从院子里走。
Walking has become a daily task for me now — I just follow the path around the yard.
走路成任务：walking has become a task
一般就七八千步就走掉了。
Usually I clock up seven or eight thousand steps.
七八千步：seven or eight thousand steps
下午再稍微走一走，就凑到一万步。
A little more walking in the afternoon and I hit ten thousand.
凑到一万步：hit ten thousand steps
paraphrase: 走路从热爱变成任务→节奏已变
Walking went from passion to routine — the pace of life changed.
一万步=拼过之后的身体需求
Ten thousand steps is a body demanding recovery after all the grinding.
scenes.speak: Walking has become a daily task for me now — I just follow the path around the yard. Usually I clock up seven or eight thousand steps. A little more walking in the afternoon and I hit ten thousand.

scenes.title_en: Grinding is the real startup norm
scenes.context: 讲者提醒年轻人不要把他现在的状态当常态，公司常态是十几个小时的拼命。
sentences: 任何年轻人、创业者看到我现在这样状态，不要以为是常态。
Young people and founders seeing me like this shouldn't mistake it for the norm.
以为是常态：mistake it for the norm
一天到晚十几个小时要拼命跑客户、联系业务、要做技术储备。
It's twelve-plus hours a day chasing clients, handling deals, and building technical capability.
跑客户：chasing clients
那个才是公司的常态，我只不过是我拼的时间太长，是拼不住了。
That's the real norm of a company — I just ground for so long that I can't keep it up anymore.
拼不住了：can't keep it up anymore
paraphrase: 养生是结果→不是创业的起点
Health mode is the result of grinding, not the starting point.
拼命时间长→身体到了临界点
Years of grinding eventually hits a physical limit.
scenes.speak: Young people and founders seeing me like this shouldn't mistake it for the norm. It's twelve-plus hours a day chasing clients, handling deals, and building technical capability. That's the real norm of a company — I just ground for so long that I can't keep it up anymore.

scenes.title_en: A different phase, so I can step back
scenes.context: 讲者说明不后悔、回到当时还会那么拼，因为人生与事业阶段不一样了。
sentences: 如果我现在回到当时的状态里头去，我还会那么拼。
If I could go back to that stage, I'd grind just the same.
回到当时：go back to that stage
我并不后悔，说我当初早知道应该怎么怎么样——没有这一说。
And I don't regret it. No "if only I'd known back then" — that doesn't exist for me.
没有这一说：that doesn't exist / no such thing
人生阶段不一样了、事业阶段不一样了，所以我才能跳脱一点。
Life phases shift and business phases shift, which is exactly why I can step back now.
跳脱：step back / take a step away
paraphrase: 不后悔→拼命是那个阶段的最优解
No regrets — grinding was the best move for that phase.
I can step back precisely because the phase has changed.
scenes.speak: If I could go back to that stage, I'd grind just the same. And I don't regret it. No "if only I'd known back then" — that doesn't exist for me. Life phases shift and business phases shift, which is exactly why I can step back now.

practice: Walking has become a daily routine — I clock up ten thousand steps.
Twelve-plus hours of grinding is the real startup norm.
I ground for so long I just can't keep it up anymore.
My life phase has shifted, so I can step back now.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Walking is a task for me now.
✓ 地道说法：Walking has become a daily task — I clock up ten thousand steps.
clock up 表达「累计步数」更口语。
✓ 地道说法：I can't keep it up anymore.
keep it up 表达「撑不住、维持不了」。
✕ 直译腔：Life stage is not the same as before.
✓ 地道说法：My life phase has shifted.
phase has shifted 更简洁自然。
✕ 直译腔：I can take off a little now.
✓ 地道说法：I can finally step back a bit.
step back 表达「抽身、跳脱」。
shifts: 养生是拼过之后才有的阶段切换
知道创业常态是十几个小时的拼命
接受阶段不同，重新选择依然那么拼
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「跑业务」等按语境整理，「业务储备」校正为「技术储备」，「自拔」校正为「不后悔（坦然）」，「今天开始又要回到公司去啊要主管」校正为「回到公司去主导」，「自己」校正为「自己」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
